2.english_reference: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble ;

traditions.WLC: יַֽעַנְ ךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּ י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה

traditions.VUL: Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis :
traditions.KJV: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble ;

2.english_reference: the name of the God of Jacob defend thee ;

traditions.LXX: ὑπερασπίσαι σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰακώβ .
traditions.KJV: the name of the God of Jacob defend thee ;

3.english_reference: Send thee help from the sanctuary

traditions.LXX: ἐξαποστείλαι σοι βοήθειαν ἐξ ἁγίου ,
traditions.KJV: Send thee help from the sanctuary ,

3.english_reference: and strengthen thee out of Zion

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκ Σιὼν ἀντιλάβοιτό σου ·
traditions.KJV: and strengthen thee out of Zion ;

traditions.LXX: μνησθείη πάσης θυσίας σου ,
traditions.KJV: Remember all thy offerings ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμά σου πιανάτω .
traditions.KJV: and accept thy burnt sacrifice ;

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

5.english_reference: Grant thee according to thine own heart

traditions.WLC: יִֽתֶּן לְ ךָ֥ כִ לְבָבֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: δῴη σοι κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου ,
traditions.KJV: Grant thee according to thine own heart ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν βουλήν σου πληρώσαι .
traditions.KJV: and fulfil all thy counsel .

6.english_reference: We will rejoice in thy salvation ,

traditions.LXX: ἀγαλλιασώμεθα ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ,
traditions.KJV: We will rejoice in thy salvation ,

6.english_reference: and in the name of our God we will set up [ our ] banners :

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ שֵֽׁם אֱלֹהֵ֥י נוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ὀνόματι θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα .
traditions.VUL: et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur .
traditions.KJV: and in the name of our God we will set up [ our ] banners :

6.english_reference: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions .

traditions.LXX: πληρώσαι Κύριος πάντα τὰ αἰτήματά σου .
traditions.KJV: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions .

7.english_reference: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed

traditions.WLC: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥ וֹ
traditions.LXX: νῦν ἔγνων ὅτι ἔσωσεν Κύριος τὸν χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: nunc cognóvi quóniam salvum fecit Dóminus Christum suum .
traditions.KJV: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed ;

7.english_reference: he will hear him from his holy heaven

traditions.WLC: יַ֭עֲנֵ הוּ מִ שְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑ וֹ

traditions.VUL: Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo :
traditions.KJV: he will hear him from his holy heaven

7.english_reference: with the saving strength of his right hand

traditions.LXX: ἐν δυναστείαις ἡ σωτηρία τῆς δεξιᾶς αὐτοῦ .
traditions.KJV: with the saving strength of his right hand .

traditions.VUL: Hi in cúrribus , et hi in equis :
traditions.KJV: Some [ trust ] in chariots , and some in horses :

8.english_reference: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנַ֓חְנוּ בְּ שֵׁם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י נוּ נַזְכִּֽיר
traditions.LXX: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα .
traditions.VUL: nos autem in nómine Dómini Dei nostri invocábimus .
traditions.KJV: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God .

9.english_reference: They are brought down and fallen

traditions.LXX: αὐτοὶ συνεποδίσθησαν καὶ ἔπεσαν ,
traditions.KJV: They are brought down and fallen :

9.english_reference: but we are risen , and stand upright

traditions.LXX: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἀνέστημεν καὶ ἀνωρθώθημεν .

traditions.KJV: but we are risen , and stand upright .

traditions.KJV: Save , LORD :

traditions.LXX: τὸν βασιλέα σου , καὶ ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλεσώμεθά σε .
